name: Company Brief
summary: Collect sourced company facts, verify the evidence, assess customer fit, and review a grounded email draft. Manual research and fixed templates; no contact harvesting or sending.

create.name: title
create.label: Brief name
create.help: For example: Acme — autumn outreach research

create.name: website
create.label: Company website
create.help: An http or https company URL.

create.name: icp
create.label: Ideal customer profile phrases
create.help: Comma-separated phrases, such as logistics, warehouse. The assessment reports literal matches in verified facts; you decide the fit.

create.name: offer
create.label: Your offer
create.help: Describe what you can actually provide. This is your own statement and is included in the email template.

actions.label: Add company source
actions.help: Capture company-level information and its public URL. A source is evidence you supply; it is not independently verified by the application.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Source URL
fields.help: A public company-level page you have checked. No scraping is performed.

fields.name: content
fields.label: Published company text
fields.help: Paste the relevant text from the source. Keep personal contact details out of this research.

actions.label: Add sourced company fact
actions.help: Choose a source and copy its supporting quote. New facts remain unverified until you check them.

fields.name: statement
fields.label: Company fact
fields.help: A concrete, checkable statement supported by the source.

fields.name: quote
fields.label: Exact supporting quote
fields.help: Copy the relevant words from the source text. Whitespace differences are allowed; invented quotes are rejected.

actions.label: Verify a company fact
actions.help: Read the fact, quote, and original source. Only facts you explicitly verify enter the research and email draft.

fields.name: confirmed
fields.label: I checked this company-level statement against its quoted source

actions.label: Review research and fit
actions.help: Check verified facts and the phrase overlap assessment. The fit decision and notes are your judgment. Unverified facts are excluded.

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Why this company fits or does not fit

fields.name: confirmed
fields.label: I reviewed the verified facts, their sources, and the ICP assessment

actions.label: Create email draft
actions.help: Builds a fixed template from up to three verified facts and your offer. Review the current research first. No email is sent.

actions.label: Revise email draft
actions.help: Replace the full subject and body. Keep company claims supported by the attached evidence. Editing clears email approval.

actions.label: Approve email draft
actions.help: Check the full draft and its cited evidence. Approval enables the text export; it does not send an email.

fields.name: confirmed
fields.label: Every company claim is supported and our offer is accurate

actions.label: Replace a company fact
actions.help: Revising a fact clears its verification and makes research and email reviews stale.

fields.name: statement
fields.label: Company fact
fields.help: A concrete, checkable statement supported by the source.

fields.name: quote
fields.label: Exact supporting quote
fields.help: Copy the relevant words from the source text. Whitespace differences are allowed; invented quotes are rejected.

actions.label: Replace a company source
actions.help: Paste the complete replacement. Linked facts become stale and must be updated and verified. Earlier source versions remain available.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Source URL
fields.help: A public company-level page you have checked. No scraping is performed.

fields.name: content
fields.label: Published company text
fields.help: Paste the relevant text from the source. Keep personal contact details out of this research.

actions.label: Update company and offer
actions.help: Replace the profile fields. A different company name or website requires every fact to be verified again. Any profile change requires a fresh research review and email draft.

fields.help: Comma-separated phrases, such as logistics, warehouse. The assessment reports literal matches in verified facts; you decide the fit.
